therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: untreated patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety (adverse events grade ≥3 and immune-mediated adverse events)

results.effect_size: ORR 54.5% (95% CI: 44.7–64.2), median PFS 6.1 months (95% CI: 5.2–6.9), median OS 9.6 months (95% CI: 7.8–11.3)
safety_signals: Cardiac events including atrial flutter, cardiac failure, cardio-respiratory arrest
results.dose_information: Durvalumab 1500 mg IV infusion over 60 minutes on Day 1 of each cycle, combined with cisplatin or carboplatin plus etoposide

context.duration: median 6 months treatment duration, up to 30 months follow-up
